desc: After 096 finishes the class-R3 semantics, determine whether bounded reads of logical USB config/status 0x23 (4 bytes) and 0x24 (9 bytes) are genuinely observation-only. Update docs/SPMI_SAFETY.md if and only if that proof holds, then build/review an exact right-HPM2 candidate that replays the proven identity+WAKEUP+SSPS precondition and reads only 0x20/0x23/0x24. No 0x14/0x55 write, mask/clear/W1C, role/VBUS, repeater, PHY, USB, or storage. Stop without a live artifact if semantics remain ambiguous.
